# gigahost_server_name (Resource)

Sets the descriptive label on an existing server. Destroying this resource resets the label to the server's auto-generated hostname.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_server" "example" {
  type     = "value"
  size     = "2c-4gb-40gb"
  os       = "debian-12"
  hostname = "web01"
}

# Set a descriptive label on the server. Destroying this resource resets the
# label to the server's auto-generated hostname.
resource "gigahost_server_name" "example" {
  server_id = gigahost_server.example.id
  name      = "my-web-server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Descriptive name / label for the server.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Alias of `server_id` to satisfy the Terraform resource model.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Find the server ID:
#   gigahost servers list
terraform import gigahost_server_name.example SERVER_ID
```
